root_cause.text: The function pcs_add_gpio_func() leaks a device_node reference obtained from of_parse_phandle_with_args() on each loop iteration because it never calls of_node_put() on gpiospec.np.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds of_node_put(gpiospec.np) both after successfully adding the GPIO range and in the error path when devm_kzalloc() fails, confirming the missing release.
